summary: Platform engineer with nine years across logistics and analytics companies. Runs the Kubernetes estate and the delivery pipeline for a 40-engineer organisation, and is the person paged when either breaks. Prefers boring infrastructure, written-down runbooks and deleting services.

bullets: Consolidated 14 Kubernetes clusters into 3, cutting the monthly cloud bill by 31% and the on-call rota from 9 engineers to 4.
Rebuilt the delivery pipeline on GitHub Actions and Argo CD; median lead time from merge to production fell from 2 days to 35 minutes.
Ran incident command for 22 customer-facing incidents; wrote the postmortem template the whole engineering organisation now uses.
Introduced Terraform modules with policy checks, so a new environment is a pull request instead of a two-week ticket.
Moved 60 batch jobs from cron on a single host to Kubernetes CronJobs with Prometheus alerting; missed runs went from weekly to zero in a quarter.
Designed the observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki) and the SLOs the product teams still report against.
Cut PostgreSQL storage cost 45% by moving cold partitions to object storage with a Go tool the team still maintains.
Built the Go services behind the customer portal and the Python tooling that deployed them.
Owned the CI servers; halved build times by caching Docker layers and splitting the test suite.
